.sy{color:var(--mu);line-height:1.5;font-size:15px}.vid{aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;margin:12px 0;background:#000}

 xbox:{n:"Xbox",g:["#0b6b2c","#22c55e"],d:"Xbox One, Series X|S",ic:"🟢",s:`<rect x="14" y="20" width="68" height="34" rx="16" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="48" cy="26" r="7" fill="#16a34a"/><path d="M44 22l8 8m0-8l-8 8" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/><g fill="#16a34a"><circle cx="66" cy="34" r="3"/><circle cx="73" cy="41" r="3"/><rect x="24" y="36" width="12" height="4" rx="1"/><rect x="28" y="32" width="4" height="12" rx="1"/></g>`},
 pc:{n:"PC",g:["#5b21b6","#a855f7"],d:"Steam y más",ic:"🖥️",s:`<rect x="12" y="8" width="72" height="40" rx="5" fill="#fff"/><rect x="17" y="13" width="62" height="30" rx="2" fill="#7c3aed"/><rect x="42" y="48" width="12" height="8" fill="#e9d5ff"/><rect x="30" y="56" width="36" height="4" rx="2" fill="#fff"/>`},
 nin:{n:"Nintendo",g:["#b91c1c","#ef4444"],d:"Switch y Switch 2",ic:"🔴",s:`<rect x="10" y="14" width="16" height="38" rx="7" fill="#38bdf8"/><rect x="70" y="14" width="16" height="38" rx="7" fill="#fff"/><rect x="28" y="12" width="40" height="42" rx="3" fill="#111827"/><rect x="31" y="16" width="34" height="34" rx="2" fill="#fca5a5"/>`}
};
const KEYS=["day","dsc","ps","xbox","pc","nin"];
const cop=n=>"$"+n.toLocaleString("es-CO")+" COP";
let tab="day",q="",lim=60;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
function seeded(seed){return()=>{seed|=0;seed=seed+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(seed^seed>>>15,1|seed);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
function delDia(){
  const d=new Date(),seed=d.getFullYear()*10000+(d.getMonth()+1)*100+d.getDate(),r=seeded(seed);
  const all=[];["ps","xbox","pc","nin"].forEach(k=>DATA[k].forEach((j,i)=>{if(j.i)all.push({...j,k,ix:i});}));
  for(let i=all.length-1;i>0;i--){const m=Math.floor(r()*(i+1));[all[i],all[m]]=[all[m],all[i]];}
  return all.slice(0,DEL_DIA);
}
const DAY=delDia();
const DEAL_N=30; // cuántas ofertas salen por semana
function ofertas(){
  const d=new Date(),wk=Math.floor((d-new Date(d.getFullYear(),0,1))/604800000),r=seeded(d.getFullYear()*100+wk+7);
  const all=[];["ps","xbox","pc","nin"].forEach(k=>DATA[k].forEach((j,i)=>{if(j.rf&&j.p<j.rf&&j.p>=j.cm)all.push({k,ix:i});}));
  for(let i=all.length-1;i>0;i--){const m=Math.floor(r()*(i+1));[all[i],all[m]]=[all[m],all[i]];}
  return all.slice(0,DEAL_N);
}
const DEALS=ofertas().map(o=>({...DATA[o.k][o.ix],k:o.k,ix:o.ix})),DSET=new Set(DEALS.map(o=>o.k+":"+o.ix));
const isDeal=(j,k,i)=>DSET.has(k+":"+i);
const priceTxt=(j,k,i)=>isDeal(j,k,i)?`<b>${cop(j.p)}</b> <span class="old">${cop(j.rf)}</span><span class="off">-${Math.round(100-100*j.p/j.rf)}%</span>`:(j.rf?`Desde <b>${cop(j.rf)}</b>`:`<b>${cop(j.p)}</b>`);
const desde=n=>n?cop(n):"—";
function detalle(j,k){
  const L=j.L; if(!L) return `<div class="ln">Precio: <b>${cop(j.p)}</b></div>`;
  if(k==="ps") return ["P","S"].filter(c=>L[c]).map(c=>`<div class="ln"><b>Cuenta ${c=="P"?"Principal":"Secundaria"}</b> — ${[L[c][0]?"PS5: "+cop(L[c][0]):"",L[c][1]?"PS4: "+cop(L[c][1]):""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</div>`).join("");
  if(k==="nin") return L.map(v=>`<div class="ln"><b>${esc(v[0])}</b> — ${[v[1]?"Switch 1: "+cop(v[1]):"",v[2]?"Switch 2: "+cop(v[2]):""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</div>`).join("");
  return `<div class="ln">Precio: <b>${cop(L)}</b></div>`;
}
const list0=()=>tab==="day"?DAY:tab==="dsc"?DEALS:DATA[tab].map((j,i)=>({...j,k:tab,ix:i}));
function nav(){$("nav").innerHTML=KEYS.map(k=>`<button class="${k==tab?"on":""}" data-k="${k}">${PL[k].ic} ${PL[k].n}<small>${k=="day"?DAY.length:k=="dsc"?DEALS.length:DATA[k].length}</small></button>`).join("");}
function banner(){const p=PL[tab],[a,b]=p.g;$("ban").style.background=`linear-gradient(135deg,${a},${b})`;
  $("ban").innerHTML=`<img src="${LOGO}" alt="Falg Play"><div class="t"><h2>${p.n}</h2><p>${p.d}${tab=="day"?" · "+new Date().toLocaleDateString("es-CO",{day:"numeric",month:"long"}):""}</p></div>${svg(a,b,p.s)}`;}
function render(){
  banner();nav();
  const list=list0().filter(j=>j.n.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  $("cnt").textContent=list.length+" juegos";
  $("grid").innerHTML=list.slice(0,lim).map(j=>{const [a,b]=PL[j.k].g;return `<button class="card" data-k="${j.k}" data-i="${j.ix}"><div class="art" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,${a},${b})">${j.i?`<img src="${j.i}" alt="" loading="lazy">`:esc(j.n.trim()[0].toUpperCase())}</div><div class="nm">${esc(j.n)}</div><div class="pl">${tab=="day"||tab=="dsc"?PL[j.k].n+" · ":""}${priceTxt(j,j.k,j.ix)}</div></button>`}).join("");
  $("more").style.display=list.length>lim?"block":"none";
}
function abrir(j,k,ix){const deal=isDeal(j,k,ix);
  const plat=PL[k].n,sin=SINOPSIS[j.n]||j.s||"Sinopsis próximamente.";
  const msg=encodeURIComponent(MENSAJE({n:j.n,plat}));
  const vid=VIDEOS[j.n]?`<iframe class="vid" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${VIDEOS[j.n]}" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe>`:"";
  const yt="https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query="+encodeURIComponent(j.n+" tráiler oficial");
  $("md").innerHTML=`<button class="x" id="cl">×</button>${j.i?`<img src="${j.i}" alt="" style="float:left;width:84px;border-radius:10px;margin:0 14px 8px 0">`:""}<div class="tag">${plat}${j.pl?" · "+esc(j.pl):""}</div><h2>${esc(j.n)}</h2>
  <div class="pr">${deal?`🏷️ Oferta de la semana: <b>${cop(j.p)}</b> <span class="old">${cop(j.rf)}</span><span class="off">-${Math.round(100-100*j.p/j.rf)}%</span><div class="ln">Precio regular:</div>`:""}${detalle(j,k)}</div><p class="sy">${esc(sin)}</p>${vid}
  ${vid?"":`<a class="btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${yt}">▶ Ver tráiler en YouTube</a>`}
  ${j.u?`<a class="btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${esc(j.u)}">Ficha oficial</a>`:""}
  <a class="btn wa" id="wa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/${WHATSAPPS[0]}?text=${msg}">💬 Comprar por WhatsApp</a>
  <a class="btn ig" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${INSTAGRAM}">📸 Síguenos en Instagram</a>`;
  $("wa").onclick=e=>{e.currentTarget.href="https://wa.me/"+WHATSAPPS[Math.random()<0.5?0:1]+"?text="+msg;};
  $("ov").classList.add("on");
}
const menu=o=>{$("side").classList.toggle("on",o);$("shade").classList.toggle("on",o);};
$("menu").onclick=()=>menu(true);$("shade").onclick=$("cls").onclick=()=>menu(false);
$("nav").onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(b){tab=b.dataset.k;lim=60;q="";$("q").value="";render();menu(false);scrollTo(0,0);}};
$("q").oninput=e=>{q=e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();lim=60;render();};
$("more").onclick=()=>{lim+=60;render();};
$("grid").onclick=e=>{const c=e.target.closest(".card");if(c){const k=c.dataset.k,i=+c.dataset.i;abrir(DATA[k][i],k,i);}};
$("ov").onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==="ov"||e.target.id==="cl"){$("ov").classList.remove("on");$("md").innerHTML="";}};
$("sig").href=INSTAGRAM;$("swa").onclick=e=>{e.currentTarget.href="https://wa.me/"+WHATSAPPS[Math.random()<0.5?0:1]+"?text="+encodeURIComponent("Hola "+EMPRESA+", quiero más información.");};
$("cp").onclick=async()=>{const b=$("cp");try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href);b.textContent="✓";}catch(e){prompt("Copia este enlace:",location.href);}setTimeout(()=>b.textContent="🔗",1800);};
render();
</script></body></html>
